def present(name, auth=None, **kwargs):
    """
    Ensure image exists and is up-to-date

    name
        Name of the image

    enabled
        Boolean to control if image is enabled

    description
        An arbitrary description of the image
    """
    ret = {"name": name, "changes": {}, "result": True, "comment": ""}

    if auth:
        client = auth.sdk.image
        kwargs.update(auth.get_auth_dict())
    else:
        client = salt.cloud.clouds.ecl.ecl_image.ECLImage(kwargs)

    try:
        image = client.get_image(name)
    except Exception as exc:
        ret["result"] = False
        ret["comment"] = "Error: {0}".format(exc)
        return ret

    if not image:
        ret["result"] = False
        ret["comment"] = "Image '{0}' not found.".format(name)
        return ret

    # Update image
    if __opts__["test"]:
        ret["result"] = None
        ret["comment"] = "Image '{0}' would be updated.".format(name)
        return ret

    try:
        image = client.update_image(name, **kwargs)
    except Exception as exc:
        ret["result"] = False
        ret["comment"] = "Error: {0}".format(exc)
        return ret

    ret["comment"] = "Image '{0}' updated.".format(name)
    ret["changes"]["old"] = image
    ret["changes"]["new"] = image

    return ret
